Kyrylo "ANGE1" Karasov (born September 10, 1989) is a retired Ukrainian professional Counter-Strike: Global Offensive and Counter-Strike player. He became inactive on May 4, 2020 to pursue a career in VALORANT before officially retiring on August 12, 2020 after being signed by FunPlus Phoenix in VALORANT. [1]
